subject: Staggered invoicing proposal and EU VAT reconciliation
messages:
From: Sarah Knox <sarah.knox@novamed.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: NovaMed Finance <finance@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-12-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Payment terms & VAT routing for EU entity

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you had a good holiday break. Quick one from procurement as we kick off planning for Q1 consumption: we need to align Redwood invoicing with our EU subsidiary (NovaMed GmbH) for VAT purposes. Can you confirm you can invoice to the GmbH once we provide the VAT registration number?

Separately, Procurement is asking whether we can move the initial pilot onto Net60 for the first quarter to match our cashflow calendar. We're also requesting a temporary credit increase from $200k to $500k while the pilot runs (we'll provide a PO).

Attached is our VAT registration stub and the procurement contact if you need more details.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Knox
Sr. Procurement Manager, NovaMed
phone: +44 20 7946 01
attachments: novamed-vat-registration.pdf (pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Knox <sarah.knox@novamed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-02T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT routing for EU entity

Sarah — thanks for the note and the VAT stub. Looping in Marcus (finance) and Lauren (ops) so we can confirm constraints from our side.

Short answers up front:
- We can invoice NovaMed GmbH once you confirm the full VAT ID and billing address; we will need the legal entity name exactly as registered.
- We can support a staggered invoice schedule and a limited Net60 for the first month, but we have a couple of asks to protect both sides.

Proposal (flexible, but actionable):
1) Invoicing routing: Redwood will issue invoices to NovaMed GmbH (German VAT reverse-charge or local VAT handling depending on the ID you provide). Please confirm VAT ID + billing address.
2) Payment cadence for pilot: 25% due on invoice (Net30) as an initial partial to cover provisioning, 50% invoiced mid-pilot (Net45), remaining 25% on acceptance/start of month 2 (Net45). We can convert the mid/remaining invoices to Net60 for this first quarter only if NovaMed signs the attached SOW and provides the PO.
3) Credit increase: we can provisionally uplift your credit to $500k for the pilot window contingent on the signed SOW and an initial partial payment (25%). After 60 days we'll review utilization and payment performance for a permanent increase.
4) Early-pay discount: 1% if invoice paid within 15 days (optional).

Attachments: proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx (editable), vat-invoicing-checklist.pdf (what we need to issue to a GmbH). Marcus — if you can confirm whether the conditional Net60 rollout and provisional uplift need additional approvals from Treasury, noted and appreciated. Lauren — can you prepare the SOW + DocuSign and I'll share the proposed schedule if Sarah confirms the billing entity?

Happy to hop on a short call this week if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
cc: Marcus Lin (Finance), Lauren Bishop (Sales Ops)
attachments: proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx, vat-invoicing-checklist.pdf

- Billing address: Beispielstraße 12, 10115 Berlin, Germany

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-01-04T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT routing for EU entity

Sarah — appreciate the quick confirmation and the VAT ID & address. We can accommodate the constraints you mentioned. Finalizing our approach below so procurement has a single doc to review: 

Final agreed approach (pilot window):
- Billing: Redwood will invoice NovaMed GmbH with the VAT ID DE123456789 clearly on each invoice. We will use the address you provided and include the VAT checklist details.
- Payment cadence (conditional): 25% initial provisioning charge will be taken on the company card authorization you offered (we will process a one-time authorization for $75,000). If the card authorization is not available, we will require the 25% upfront via invoice (Net30).
- Remainder invoicing: Mid-pilot 50% and final 25% will be issued as Net60 for this first quarter only. After 60 days post-launch we will review payment history and either move back to standard Net45 or approve a longer-term Net60.
- Credit uplift: Provisional increase to $500k upon signed SOW and PO; permanent uplift subject to 60-day review.
- Early-pay discount: 1% within 15 days as previously offered.

Next steps:
1) Lauren will send a DocuSign SOW and the attached final invoice schedule for signature.
2) Sarah — please confirm whether you want the initial card authorization or to receive an invoice for the 25% provisioning charge.
3) Marcus will create a conditional credit memorandum for Treasury approval (cc'd).

I'll attach the signed-sow-redwood-novamed.pdf (placeholder) and the finalized proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx for your procurement review. If that sounds good I'll mark this as agreed and Lauren will trigger DocuSign.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you onboarded smoothly.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
